name: MonarchAiConversationHeader
title: AiConversationHeader
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row on the surface color for a androidx.compose.material3.Scaffold topBar, with MonarchInlineEditText for rename, MonarchAiAgentAvatar and app slots for the navigation icon, the model and the actions
summary: The top bar of an AI conversation: the title with rename, the assistant and model in use, and the conversation's actions.
whenToUse: As the topBar of a Scaffold that shows one AI conversation, when people should see and rename its title and see which assistant and model answer.
whenNotToUse: For an ordinary screen title use a Material 3 TopAppBar; for the list of conversations use MonarchAiConversationList.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAiConversationHeader(title: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, agent: MonarchAiAgentRef? = null, agentImage: Painter? = null, naming: Boolean = false, onRename: (suspend (String) -> Unit)? = null, navigationIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, renameIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, model: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiConversationHeaderLabels = MonarchAiConversationHeaderLabels(), actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchAiConversationHeaderLabels(untitled: String? = null, rename: String? = null, titleLabel: String? = null, naming: String? = null, agent: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, actions: String? = null, renameFailed: String? = null, inlineEdit: MonarchInlineEditTextLabels = MonarchInlineEditTextLabels())

options.name: title
options.description: The conversation's title. Empty or blank shows "New conversation" in the muted color.

options.name: agent
options.description: The assistant, shown under the title with a small MonarchAiAgentAvatar.

options.name: agentImage
options.description: The assistant's picture, loaded by the app; null shows initials.

options.name: naming
options.description: The title is being generated: shows "Naming conversation…" and offers no rename.

options.name: onRename
options.description: Makes the title renamable; called with the trimmed new title. Throw to keep the editor open with the failure message.

options.name: navigationIcon
options.description: The back or menu button at the start.

options.name: renameIcon
options.description: A decorative icon after a renamable title, such as a pencil. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: model
options.description: The model in use: a MonarchAiModelPicker or a short Text, after the assistant.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the rename editor's.

options.name: actions
options.description: The conversation's actions at the end, such as IconButtons for Share and More.

states.name: titled
states.description: The title as a heading in the default text color.

states.name: naming
states.description: "Naming conversation…" in the muted color, with that state for TalkBack; rename is not offered.

states.name: renaming
states.description: The title is replaced by MonarchInlineEditText's field with Save and Cancel; Save shows progress while onRename runs.

states.name: rename failed
states.description: The editor stays open with "Couldn’t rename. Try again." and the draft.

appearance: The bar is on the surface color with a subtle line under it. The title uses the subheading style in the default text color, or the muted color while it is a placeholder; the assistant's name and the model are in the muted color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web AiConversationHeader is a block with an inline input for rename (Enter saves, Escape cancels) and a pencil MonarchIconButton. On Android it is a top bar for a Scaffold: a Material 3 TopAppBar has a fixed height that cuts the second line and a model picker at large font sizes, so the bar is a Row of at least 64dp that grows. The whole title is the rename button (with a TalkBack action label "Rename conversation"), and rename uses MonarchInlineEditText's editor with Save and Cancel buttons; the pencil is an optional decorative slot because Monarch bundles no icons. onRename is a suspending function instead of a promise. The web's headingLevel has no Android equivalent: the title is a heading. The model slot is not prefixed with "Model:" for TalkBack; give the slot its own description. Experimental until a Rook app adopts it. No iOS entry exists yet.
accessibility: The title is a heading and a polite live region, so a generated title is announced when it arrives.
A renamable title is one button with the action label "Rename conversation" and a 48dp touch target.
While naming, the title's state is "Naming conversation…".
The assistant is read as "AI assistant: Name"; its avatar is decorative.
The actions are a traversal group named "Conversation actions".
edgeCases: A blank or unchanged rename closes the editor without calling onRename.
Long titles wrap; the bar grows instead of cutting them.
Without agent and model the meta line is left out.
